correctness.rationale: Every interval fiber is explicitly classified by actual integer shifts; Fourier-series fiberization is unitary. Vandermonde chord products give exact formulas A,B,C with no missing density factor. Symbolic differentiation supplies strict global monotonic bounds on three frequency ranges, all optimizer equalities and nonzero determinant at the maximizing shifts. Numerical and symbolic CHECK.py tests are supplementary; the proof covers every delta in (0,1) and every tau in (0,1). The objective is unambiguously a determinant, not a condition number.

value.rationale: For the first nontrivial arithmetic progression of three separated unit intervals, optimize the natural uniform local squared-volume invariant for three equally spaced frequency cosets. Exact maximin values, all optimizing shifts, and a jump at a half-interval gap give structurally new D-optimal Fourier-sampling information beyond qualitative basis existence. A determinant gives a conservative lower reconstruction bound via trace nine. The scope is explicitly not generalized to all frequency patterns or to condition-number optimality.
